name: Phoenix Leap
primary:
A fiery dash that leaves a burning trail.
Dash where you look. On you:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 3.75 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
For half a second you leave a trail of 1-block zones lasting 2 s; every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Heals 1 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 6 s
• Growth: up to 2 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 3.6 blocks with 30% health
• Puts out fire
